inputs.text: [curious] ed… ah… foh… SOR… us. "Edaphos," in Greek, means the ground, the paving stone — [serious] flat rock. And "saurus," lizard.
[happily] Close — the lizard with paving-stone teeth. [amazed] He had dozens of little teeth packed tight, [serious] like paving stones in a street, for crushing plants.
[confident] In Texas, two hundred eighty million years ago — [serious] way before the first dinosaurs. He's not a dinosaur either.
